title: Seams and cuts
notes: Keep one adult at each of three tables; the adult performs the cuts while children predict and retrace. A first visit can stay with P1-2 edge trips and two-dot reachability, adding P3 only when seam tracking is reliable. On return, K-1 and grades 2-3 can use the middle cuts and retracing (P4-5), then the four-dot questions (P6-7). Grades 4-5 can separate the piece/boundary explanation (P4-5) from the transported-arrow investigation (P6) and classification (P7). Prepare spare uncut bands before the return visit. The physical seam/cut/arrow test on guide p2 is still unperformed.
